 See what the stars have in store for your sign By Snehaa Khanna Sahgal 2 November 2026 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Something exciting came up; you took the chance, and Scorpio , this being your birth season, how can the cosmos disappoint you? Things are beginning to work out in mysterious but consistent ways. You are going to be in a good place soon, also for some of you, what you began in Leo season is reaping rewards now and what you are working on now, will again tangify solidly by the next Leo season. It is the extrovert in you that helps connect the dots, but it is important for you to also water that part of you that needs rest and rejuvenation.
 Cosmic tip: Seed what's in your heart into the ground.
